text.**Seu Silva #14 — O pão por aplicativo**:
**Mr. Silva #14 — Bread by app**

Mr. Silva downloads the bakery app to order "the usual". Sign-up asks for an ID number and a photo; he sends a photo of the bread. The order never arrives. At the counter, the clerk prints the order on paper and hands him the bread. Mr. Silva: "Technology."
